name: Apache ActiveMQ 6.4.0
body:
## What's Changed

### New Contributors
* @arimu1 made their first contribution in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2270
* @hai-ben made their first contribution in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2517
* @jjj-n made their first contribution in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2540

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/apache/activemq/compare/activemq-6.3.2...activemq-6.4.0

### Features
* [#2132] Migrate SSL support away from ThreadLocal, support key alias and default to pkcs12 by @mattrpav in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2133
* [AMQ-9857] Add SSL support for JMX connector in ManagementContext by @jeanouii in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/1661
* [#1770] Feature: IP address allow/deny support by @mattrpav in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2539
* [#2273] activemq-pool support for JMS 3.1/2.0 by @mattrpav in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2274
* Feature: Support for authorization of connection fields by @mattrpav in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2461
* [AMQ-9692] Support destination gc sweep of destinations with only wildcard consumers by @mattrpav in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/1484
* Add support for PageFile free page truncation by @cshannon in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2233
* feat(#1737): Add OAuth2 JWT authentication support via JAAS LoginModule by @jbonofre in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/1738
* feat(otel): Add OpenTelemetry distributed tracing support by @jbonofre in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/1769
* Docker image update to JDK 25 and README updates by @colinwerner in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2052
* feat(#1716): Implement receiveBody() by @jbonofre in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/1543
* [#2140] Widen MessageDatabase index-update points for subclasses by @mattrpav in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2550

### Fixes
* Fix AMQP Object message decompression by @cshannon in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2256
* [#2583] Duplicate message publish during failover leads to incorrect queue size metric by @mattrpav in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2584
* [#2583] Transacted fire-after-commit first exception exits loop prematurely leading to incorrect queue size by @mattrpav in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2585
* fix(console): fix NPE in AbstractJmxCommand.execute and AbstractCommand.handleException by @anmol-saxena-14 in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/1967
* Return safe fallback from BrokerView read-only getters instead of throwing when broker not yet started by @jbonofre in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2553
* StartCommand: keep waiting past the default start timeout unless a start exception was recorded by @jbonofre in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2554
* Ensure subscriptions are cleaned up on failure by @cshannon in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2680
* Ensure TransportConnection validates connection id by @cshannon in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2682
* Fix TransportConnection getConnectionId() by @cshannon in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2683
* LDAP hardening by @mattrpav in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2695
* [#9857] JMX SSL clean-up post-merge since was not rebased to new SslContext by @mattrpav in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2668
* Fix nested values in MapMessage by @cshannon in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2672
* Tighten default Jolokia access policy and bind the web console to loopback by @jbonofre in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2639
* Validate subscription key length in KahaDB by @cshannon in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2686
* Clear context write cache on ACL updates by @cshannon in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2685
* Fix network bridge local-side close by @mattrpav in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2475
* Fix: Assembly startup logs harmless WARN about schemas by @mattrpav in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2501
* Improve GC checkpoint algorithm for empty durables by @cshannon in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2505
* Fix concurrent advisory message evaluation (#2519) by @jjj-n in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2540
* [#2271] Update Producer getDeliveryDelay to always return zero by @mattrpav in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2272
* [#2398] FutureBrokerInfoTimeout is missed due to logic operator error by @mattrpav in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2399
* [#2282] Drop redundant sequence generator monitor in RegionBroker by @mattrpav in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2283
* [#2406] Guard against null region subscriptions in duplicate suppression by @mattrpav in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2407
* [#2418] Improve performance of IntSequenceGenerator by @cshannon in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2408
* [#2434] Avoid per-command MDC add+remove in TransportConnection.service by @mattrpav in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2435
* [#2436] Fix SizeStatisticImpl.addSize on isEnabled like CountStatisticImpl by @mattrpav in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2437
* [#2275] Drop redundant consumers monitor from topic dispatch empty-check by @mattrpav in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2281
* fix(jmx): avoid NPE in ConnectionView.getWireFormatInfo by @arimu1 in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2270
* fix: MQTTWireFormat rejecting valid 4-byte remaining lengths by @hai-ben in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2517

### Tasks
* Bootstrap activemq-6.3.x branch by @jbonofre in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2245
* Bump to 6.4.0-SNAPSHOT by @jbonofre in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2244
* Speed up activemq-http tests by not waiting on Jetty at shutdown by @mattrpav in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2546
* Dump network state when VirtualConsumerDemandTest misses a forwarded message by @jbonofre in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2657
* Fix reactor build for sources (used by release plugin) by @jbonofre in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2246
* Fix javadoc on activemq-osgi by @jbonofre in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2248
* [#2238] Fix flaky tests batch 1 by @mattrpav in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2428
* Update LICENSE/NOTICE  by @jbonofre in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2733
* Fix dependabot yml typo by @cshannon in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2284
* Pinning GitHub actions by @coheigea in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2447
* test: Fix flaky NetworkBridgeReconnectOnHandshakeFailureTest (#2238) by @jbonofre in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2624
* Fix flaky TwoBrokerVirtualTopicSelectorAwareForwardingTest (link #2238) by @jbonofre in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2625
* build: make surefire enableProcessChecker overridable for Windows 11 compatibility. by @anmol-saxena-14 in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/1968
* Disable dependabot on 6.2.x by @cshannon in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2455
* [#2446] Add missing jetty dependency to assembly for websockets by @mattrpav in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2481
* Fix flaky ExceptionListenerTest: wait for transport-failed before createSession by @mattrpav in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2544
* Speed up activemq-runtime-config tests by waiting for the reload instead of sleeping by @mattrpav in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2545
* [#2431] Skip topic sendLock for non-persistent sends by @mattrpav in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2432
* [#] Update TopicRegion removeSubscription to use connection clientId by @mattrpav in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2477
* Harden soTimeout vs InactivityMonitor by @mattrpav in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2474
* Update SECURITY.md by @mattrpav in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2255
* Update README.md by @mattrpav in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2458
* KEYS: Add mattrpav@apache.org GPG release key by @mattrpav in https://github.com/apache/activemq/pull/2497
